source: R. Lu, Y. Yang, S. Link, S. Gong, "Low-loss 5-GHz first-order antisymmetric mode acoustic delay lines in thin-film lithium niobate," IEEE Trans. Microw. Theory Techn. 69(1), 541-550 (2021)
structure: Suspended Z-cut LiNbO3, 490 nm thick, propagation along X (Z-cut phi = 0 here). Electrodes: 30 nm Al (not modelled here; the gaps are bare LN).
transducer: 50 % duty cells of length Lambda. The paper's centre frequency satisfies f Lshort / vm + f Lopen / vf = 1 (its eq. 12): the mean of the shorted and open A1 wavenumbers equals 2 pi / Lambda.

measured.kind: measured (Sec. V and Table III): centre frequency of the passband, and group velocity from the group delay vs gap length (gaps 20-320 um)
measured.note: Groups A and E share Lambda = 2.4 um (N = 4 and 2). The paper gives group E's vg at 5 GHz in Fig. 25 and at 4.8 GHz in the text.

simulated.kind: simulated (eigenmode FEA, Sec. II-B, with the paper's own constants)
simulated.open_f_vs_lambda: f from 4.5 GHz (lambda = 6 um) to 6.0 GHz (lambda = 1.5 um), electrically open; values as rounded in the text
